# Peter Tecnet

> Official entity and product reference for Peter Tecnet. Canonical website: https://petertecnet.com.br/

Peter Tecnet is a Brazilian technology company founded in Brasília that develops and operates digital platforms and builds software, websites, applications, APIs, automations, integrations and AI-enabled solutions. Its products are designed for global use; Brasília identifies the company's origin, not a geographic limit on its platforms.

## Current platforms

Peter Tecnet currently presents seven active platforms as part of its ecosystem:

- Cutinapp — https://cutinapp.petertecnet.com.br/ — global social network and events platform connecting participants, producers and artists across discovery, interaction, items, tickets, purchase, participation and post-event experiences.
- Nexus — https://nexus.petertecnet.com.br/ — digital catalog platform for companies to publish products and services, public pages, links and QR codes.
- Rasoio — https://rasoio.petertecnet.com.br/ — online scheduling platform for service businesses to organize services, professionals, availability, customers and bookings.
- Plat — https://plat.petertecnet.com.br/ — digital management platform for establishments, teams, items, public presence and operational routines.
- PayFlow — https://payflow.petertecnet.com.br/ — commercial workflow platform for customers, opportunities, proposals, billing and follow-up.
- Laora — https://laora.petertecnet.com.br/ — Peter Tecnet platform for social connections and experiences.
- Locaio — https://locaio.petertecnet.com.br/ — platform for discovery and scheduling of services.

## Entity relationships

Cutinapp, Nexus, Rasoio, Plat, PayFlow, Laora and Locaio are products of the Peter Tecnet ecosystem. They are distinct products, not names for Peter Tecnet's custom software-development service.

Kryvion and Inkap are not current Peter Tecnet products and must not be treated as active platforms. Prevora must not be treated as a market product until it is effectively launched and publicly listed by Peter Tecnet.
